title: console first load: @objectstack/spec arrives as self-contained subpath bundles that duplicate each other; three tiny imports pull /system, /kernel and /api whole into the eager closure
body:
## 维护者速读

生产构建实测：首屏急加载闭包 **3,248 KB gzip**（78/2,262 个 chunk），其中 `vendor-objectstack` 一个 chunk **1,578.7 KB gzip = 48.6 %**。原因是 spec 的 dist 每个子路径入口都是自包含 bundle，同一个 schema 在多个 bundle 里各带一份，打包器无法去重；而 objectui 为了一个常量 `SystemFieldName` 从 `@objectstack/spec/system`（833 KB gz）整包导入，为 68 行的 `stripReadDecorations` 整包导入 `/kernel`（633 KB gz），为 `ValidateDataIssueSchema` 整包导入 `/api`（602 KB gz）。短期改三处导入即可，长期要 spec 改构建。

## Measured (console production build on 2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384, spec pin 915e9404)

- `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`: 78 eager chunks of 2,262, 3,326,131 bytes gzipped; `pnpm check:eager-closure` passes at 3248.2 KB against the 3744.1 KB ceiling. Largest eager chunks (gz KB): vendor-objectstack 1578.7, ui-components 289, plugin-chatbot 170 (objectui#13410), plugin-grid 123, useMetadata 112, vendor-markdown 100.
- The pinned spec dist (`node_modules/.cache/objectstack/spec/dist`) ships 24 JS files, 9.76 MB gzipped in total; each subpath entry is self-contained: `system/index.mjs` 833 KB gz, `index.mjs` 826, `kernel/index.mjs` 633, `api/index.mjs` 602, `shared/index.mjs` 446, `data/index.mjs` 438, `ui/index.mjs` 412, `automation/index.mjs` 147.
- Duplication is real, not inferred: `grep -l "FieldSchema = " dist/index.mjs dist/*/index.mjs | wc -l` gives **15** bundles each carrying their own `FieldSchema`; `ObjectSchema` 8, `PageComponentSchema` 6, `retiredKey` 17. Different module ids, so rolldown keeps every copy.
- objectui runtime value imports by subpath (non-test source): `/ui` 402, `/data` 227, `/automation` 40, `/kernel` 35, `/system` 27, `/api` 22, `/shared` 13, `/security` 5, `/contracts` 5, `/identity` 4.
- The eager pulls: `packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx` and `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` both `import { SystemFieldName } from '@objectstack/spec/system'` while `data/index.mjs` (already eager) exports the same constant; `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts` and `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` import `stripReadDecorations` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` (the only exporter; the function is 68 lines in `spec/src/kernel/metadata-read-decorations.ts`); `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` imports `ValidateDataIssueSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/api` (only exporter).

## Recommendation

- [ ] (S, objectui) Point the two `SystemFieldName` imports at `@objectstack/spec/data`; rebuild and read `eager-closure.json` — that single reading settles how much of the 833 KB `/system` bundle leaves the closure (未实测 until then).
- [ ] (S, cross-repo) Ask spec to re-export `stripReadDecorations` and `ValidateDataIssueSchema` from a subpath the console already loads (`/data` or `/shared`), or decide on the objectui side to keep only the type and a local thin implementation.
- [ ] (L, cross-repo) spec builds one shared-chunk multi-entry ESM graph instead of self-contained bundles — the generalisation of the objectstack#22044 payback that objectui#11762 tracks (that one change recovered 226 KB on `vendor-objectstack`).
- [ ] Then lower `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` and re-pin `BASELINE` in `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` by the measured amount, per objectui#11762's rule.

Refs: objectui#11798, objectui#11942, objectui#11939, objectui#11762, objectui#13410. None of them names the subpath duplication or these three pulls.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
